name: io.github.epistates/turbovault
title: TurboVault
description: Obsidian vaults for AI agents: read, write, search, link graph, and safe atomic edits

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Vault to open at startup. Leave unset to add vaults at runtime with add_vault.

environmentVariables.name: TURBOVAULT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Configuration profile. read-only exposes search and analysis tools only.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the vault into the container.

vault_path.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault on the host.
